summary: 《生物多样性公约》第十七次缔约方大会在埃里温开幕，将首次全球审查“昆蒙框架”落实进展。国际货币基金组织、世界银行与泰国央行发布“曼谷蓝图”，呼吁跨境合作打击金融诈骗。伊朗总统表示绝不屈服于“侵略性”国家无理要求与霸凌，军方称已制定应对方案。

summary: 中吉两国外长发表联合新闻公报，回顾建交47年成果，表示将继续相互支持并拓展务实合作。吉方赞赏中方构建人类命运共同体理念及“一带一路”和全球发展、安全、文明、治理倡议；中方赞赏吉方为维护地区和平稳定所作的贡献。双方就非洲之角局势及红海航道安全
summary_en: The foreign ministers of China and Kyrgyzstan issued a joint press communique, reviewing the achievements of 47 years of diplomatic relations and stating they will continue to support each other and expand practical cooperation. The Kyrgyz side appreciated China's concept of building a community with a shared future for mankind, as well as the Belt and Road Initiative and the Global Development, Security, Civilization, and Governance Initiatives; the Chinese side appreciated Kyrgyzstan's contribution to maintaining regional peace and stability. The two sides discussed the situation in the Horn of Africa and the security of Red Sea shipping lanes.

title: 尼泊尔努力挖掘经济潜能

summary: 尼泊尔央行报告显示，2025/2026财年经济增速预计达3.85%，通胀率控制在3.5%以下，总体温和可控。服务业贡献率为61.81%，工业稳步扩张，农业因干旱和反常降雨增速回落。进出口均实现两位数增长，国际收支盈余，外汇储备升至近3.9万
summary_en: Nepal's central bank reported that economic growth is projected at 3.85% in fiscal year 2025/2026, with inflation kept below 3.5%, generally moderate and controllable. Services contributed 61.81%, industry expanded steadily, and agricultural growth slowed due to drought and abnormal rainfall. Both exports and imports achieved double-digit growth, the balance of payments was in surplus, and foreign exchange reserves rose to nearly 3.9 trillion.
